stories.headline: AEW Collision spoilers from Wednesday: Redemption go-home show - F4W/WON
stories.summary: The following are spoilers for this Saturday's AEW Collision, taped Wednesday in Nashville, TN, after Dynamite.
stories.why: AEW's go-home shows determine if you're watching Saturday's card; this signals which storylines actually matter versus which were filler in a wrestling landscape where every taping decision affects your weekend plans.

stories.headline: Johnny Depp Makes Surprise Comic-Con Appearance as Ebenezer Scrooge - Variety
stories.summary: Johnny Depp made a surprise appearance at San Diego Comic-Con on Thursday in his full Ebenezer Scrooge regalia.
stories.why: Depp's first major public appearance since the defamation trial signals he's actively rebuilding his brand through tentpole IP rather than staying quiet—a calculated move that tests whether audiences will accept his return to franchises.

stories.headline: Heidi Klum ditches bikini top, covers up with potato chip bag on beach vacation - Fox News
stories.summary: Heidi Klum's sultry beach video shows her using a bag of potato chips as a topless cover-up in a playful nod to her new snack brand collaboration.
stories.why: A 50+ woman leveraging her body and cultural relevance for a snack brand deal shows how influencer capitalism is reshaping celebrity endorsements away from traditional gatekeepers you grew up watching.

stories.headline: Prince Archie, 7, and Princess Lilibet, 5, Look So Grown Up in Never-Before-Seen Photos Shared By Meghan Markle - instyle.com
stories.summary: Meghan Markle surprised her Instagram followers with never-before-seen photos of Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet on July 23. The two young royals looked so grown up in the photo gallery, which fea…
stories.why: Meghan controlling the narrative around her kids' images on her own terms (rather than paparazzi or tabloids) is a power play that reframes motherhood as content strategy in the post-privacy royal era.

stories.headline: Eminem's Ex-Wife Kim Scott Screams at Cops in Body Cam Video From Attempted Suicide - TMZ
stories.why: Kim Scott's public mental health crisis captured on police video raises questions about how celebrity trauma becomes real-time media spectacle and who profits from documenting vulnerability.

stories.headline: Judge Extends Emergency Order Pausing Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger - Deadline
stories.summary: The judge wants to give more time for attorneys to work out a schedule for a preliminary injunction.
stories.why: A judge blocking a major media merger means streaming consolidation is hitting real legal friction—this directly impacts which shows get greenlit, cancelled, or moved between platforms you subscribe to.
